events.verdict: Coulibaly (WAS) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Collier (UTA) during the drive and shot attempt.
Officials stop play due to a clock malfunction and reset the game clock to 1:57 remaining.
Middleton (WAS) establishes himself in Filipowski's (UTA) path, and Filipowski is able to slip by during the driving shot attempt.
Sarr (WAS) gathers the ball on his right foot and hops consecutively on the same foot after his gather.
Filipowski (UTA) retreats within Sarr's (WAS) path and maintains a legal guarding position while absorbing the incidental contact during Sarr's driving shot attempt.
Sarr (WAS) aligns himself alongside Williams' (UTA) path and he absorbs the marginal contact during Williams' drive and shot attempt in the paint.
Prior to Juzang's (UTA) contact with the ball, Filipowski (UTA) moves alongside Middleton's (WAS) path and the body contact is marginal.

Juzang (UTA) brings his right hand forward and makes contact with the ball, which causes it to become loose in Middleton's (WAS) hand prior to Juzang's hand sliding off the ball and coming into contact with Middleton's wrist. The contact with the ball causes a dislodge and the ensuing arm contact is considered incidental.
Filipowski (UTA) brings his forearm to rest on Middleton's (WAS) lower back and the contact during Middleton's layup attempt is marginal.

Carrington (WAS) moves alongside Collier's (UTA) path and brings both of his hands to the ball after Collier's gather. A held ball is correctly called, as both players maintain their hands firmly on the ball. Although there is some contact to Collier's arms, it occurs after Carrington's first contact with the ball and is considered incidental.
After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that there is no hostile act during the play and no additional penalties would be assessed.
Martin (UTA) moves alongside Coulibaly's (WAS) path and he absorbs the incidental contact during Coulibaly's drive.
Carrington (WAS) loses control of the ball on his own accord prior to coming together with Juzang (UTA). The contact from Juzang to Carrington's body is considered incidental.
George (WAS) rests and promptly removes his hand from Collier's (UTA) side.
Collier (UTA) releases the ball prior to his right foot coming down out of bounds and George (WAS) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Sarr (WAS) brings his left forearm to rest on Filipowski's (UTA) side and the contact during Filipowksi's layup attempt is marginal.
Williams (UTA) commits a take foul on George (WAS).
Carrington (WAS) legally contests Juzang's (UTA) jump shot attempt.
Middleton (WAS) does not deliver any illegal contact when setting the screen on Collier (UTA).
Collier (UTA) reaches in for the ball and initiates contact with Carrington's (WAS) arm and torso, which causes him to lose control of the ball.
Middleton (WAS) steps into Sensabaugh's (UTA) space and initiates body contact, affecting Sensabaugh's jump shot attempt.
